subject: V1.6 frozen Equal8__Buffer30_60 final account only
purpose: Post-test explanation, not model selection or a new independent test

accounting.unit: Qlib adjusted units and adjusted prices; no verified raw-share or dividend cash ledger
accounting.mark: Saved market close on ordinary days, saved market open on terminal day; forward-filled adjusted close only where original mark absent
accounting.gross_security_pnl: ending_units * ending_mark - opening_units * prior_mark + sale_notional - purchase_notional
accounting.net_security_pnl: gross_security_pnl - allocated_order_fees; execution slippage and impact are already in notional
accounting.realized_pnl: moving-average execution-price basis excluding fees; sale proceeds less released basis

factor_diagnostics.features: All 28 existing V1.6 cross-sectional technical features, no feature selection
factor_diagnostics.forward_return: Saved next-month open-to-open label; never interpreted as a factor-mimicking portfolio return
factor_diagnostics.inference: intercept-only OLS with HAC lag 3 on monthly IC, two-sided
factor_diagnostics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all 28 full-period feature tests; yearly splits descriptive only

external_ch4_regression.source: Mingshi Investment CH4 daily factor returns, source workbook supplied separately, not redistributed
external_ch4_regression.dependent: saved portfolio ordinary close-to-close daily return minus rf_dly
external_ch4_regression.columns: mktrf, SMB, VMG, PMO; original daily decimal units
external_ch4_regression.primary_period: all matched ordinary account dates in 2024-2025, complete before regression
external_ch4_regression.sensitivity: all available ordinary dates through source end 2026-08-31, with missing 2026-06 factor dates excluded and explicitly listed
external_ch4_regression.models: CH market-only and CH4 estimated on identical period rows
external_ch4_regression.inference: OLS HAC lag 5, two-sided 95% confidence interval, linear annualization times 252
external_ch4_regression.interpretation: post-test risk explanation, not new prediction test or model choice

external_data_gate.sector_brinson: Only if point-in-time industry mapping, dated CSI300 security weights and same-convention security returns are available and validated
external_data_gate.size_value_exposure: Only if historical market capitalization and point-in-time accounting data are available
external_data_gate.multifactor_regression: External CH4 daily factor file required; audit its date coverage and units before estimation
external_data_gate.corporate_actions: Only if independent unadjusted price and dividend/split/rights event source is available
external_data_gate.total_return_benchmark: Only if independently sourced CSI300 total-return daily levels align to the account boundary dates

publication: Do not publish full orders, positions, daily security P&L, or cash ledger; publish summary aggregates and limitations
